chapter.heading: God Presides in the Divine Assembly A Psalm of Asaph.
chapter.v:
God presides
in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:

“How long
will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah

Defend the
cause of the weak and fatherless;uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.

Rescue the
weak and needy;save them from the hand of the wicked.

They do
not know or understand;they wander in the darkness;all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

I have
said, ‘You are gods;you are all sons of the Most High.’

But like
mortals you will die,and like rulers you will fall.”

Arise, O
God, judge the earth,for all the nations are Your inheritance.
